test_m2 = '''"""Tests for milestone m2: VersionInfo.to_dict()"""

def test_to_dict_exists():
    import semver
    assert hasattr(semver.VersionInfo, "to_dict")
    assert callable(getattr(semver.VersionInfo, "to_dict"))


def test_to_dict_with_prerelease_and_build():
    import semver
    v = semver.VersionInfo.parse("1.2.3-rc.1+build.2")
    result = v.to_dict()
    assert isinstance(result, dict)
    expected_keys = {"major", "minor", "patch", "prerelease", "build"}
    assert set(result.keys()) == expected_keys
    assert result["major"] == 1
    assert result["minor"] == 2
    assert result["patch"] == 3
    assert result["prerelease"] == "rc.1"
    assert result["build"] == "build.2"


def test_to_dict_minimal_version():
    import semver
    v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 0, 0)
    result = v.to_dict()
    assert isinstance(result, dict)
    assert set(result.keys()) == {"major", "minor", "patch", "prerelease", "build"}
    assert result["major"] == 1
    assert result["minor"] == 0
    assert result["patch"] == 0
    assert result["prerelease"] is None
    assert result["build"] is None


def test_to_dict_no_prerelease_or_build():
    import semver
    v = semver.VersionInfo(3, 10, 7)
    result = v.to_dict()
    assert result == {"major": 3, "minor": 10, "patch": 7, "prerelease": None, "build": None}
'''

with open('crucible_hidden/test_m2.py', 'w') as f:
